413-1445-4871-6277.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
413-1445-4871-6277.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.

Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.

Stonybrook Schoolmaster triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Stonybrook Schoolmaster.

6822-7687-7690.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mister Fantastic.

2021-2060-2445-7315.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

670-1619-3668-4089.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3668-4089.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Flesh Duplicate and Glasspool Mimic each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Flesh Duplicate trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3668-4089.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

475-3197-3263-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
475-3197-3263-6824.description:
Gain life in any way.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Leonin Elder triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

997-1619-4605-5542-6150.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
997-1619-4605-5542-6150.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Tomb of Horrors Adventurer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Tomb of Horrors Adventurer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Tomb of Horrors Adventurer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Tomb of Horrors Adventurer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Tomb of Horrors Adventurer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
997-1619-4605-5542-6150.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1069-3552-5499-7296.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-3552-5499-7296.description:

Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Warrior.
Activate the Warrior by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.

1086-2308-4871-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
1086-2308-4871-5231.description:

When the Fungus Beast enters, Anointer Priest triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {R}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Anointer Priest trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Arcbound Hybrid.
When Arcbound Hybrid dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Hybrid's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Hybrid from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
5310-5929-6798-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

436-3455-5220.description:
Cast Vizier of Many Faces by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Put Vizier of Many Faces into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Vizier of Many Faces dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Vizier of Many Faces from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vizier of Many Faces trigger, causing you to look at the top seven cards of your library and put Vizier of Many Faces onto the battlefield as a copy of Ao.
Repeat from step 2.

1806-2034-5997-6997.description:

When Eternal Scourge dies, Chaos Shrine's Black Crystal triggers, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.

Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Alien Warrior and Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

141-5117-6798.description:
Cast Undying Malice by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Undying Malice, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Undying Malice.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 5.

When Otherworldly Escort enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability rom step 1.
Repeat.
